name: Yoshia no Oka de Nekoronde...
original_name: 吉亜の丘で寝ころんで…
source:
Main character used to be a best-seller writer, but lost ability to write good stories after getting sexual disability. He decides to go to hot springs resort to find his hidden self and try to get rid of his deficiency.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-july-2001-cosmos-no-sora-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公曾是畅销书作家，但在出现性功能障碍后，便失去了写出好故事的能力。他决定前往温泉度假地，寻找被隐藏的自我，并试图摆脱自己的缺陷。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-july-2001-cosmos-no-sora-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
